title: See the water from the stern and bridge
summary: View the water beyond the stern or look over the patrol ship’s port rail from the bridge roof.
stage: Beachhead, seed 3, trailer-harbour-quarter, seconds 10.9 to 14.3. Use Waterline for the left camera and Stern quarter for the right. Bridge roof comparison uses Beachhead seed 3 at 34.9 to 37.15 seconds.
rationale: Both cameras follow the same boat through the same spray, with the horizon visible above its deck.
source_ref: scripts/game/vehicle.gd and the trailer-harbour-quarter capture recipe.
